mintAuthority.headline: USDhl mints only against deposited M, while Felix's three-of-six Safe can upgrade the wrapper proxy with no timelock.
mintAuthority.summary: USDhl inherits base M issuance from reviewed m-m0 and wraps M 1:1 on HyperEVM via verified MExtension logic (wrap/unwrap with zero fee, plus permissionless claimYield() for accrued excess M). However, the USDhl token (0xb50a9625) is an EIP-1967 Transparent Upgradeable Proxy whose ProxyAdmin (0x9f834dd9) is owned without a timelock by the Felix 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe (0x699090e7), which also holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on the token.

controls.label: USDhl direct MExtension wrapper
controls.capDescription: Current verified USDHL/MExtension implementation mints USDhl only after transferring equal M0 M (0x866a2bf4...) via wrap(), or via permissionless claimYield() limited strictly to M.balanceOf(USDhl) minus USDhl.totalSupply().
controls.evidence: Verified Solidity source for 0xdb170bfe627a39145147e6ff9b258bdb59e6b4e8 inherits MExtension and Blacklistable: wrap(recipient, amount) pulls M before minting USDhl 1:1, unwrap(recipient, amount) burns USDhl before transferring M 1:1, and claimYield() mints only excess accrued M backing to yieldRecipient(). At block 52378224, M.balanceOf(USDhl) was 327,843.601117 M against 327,573.275619 USDhl total supply (exact 270.325498 M excess = yield()).

review.evidence: Pinned HyperEVM EIP-1967 and contract reads at block 52378224 (2026-11-27T10:49:26Z) established that USDhl (0xb50a96253abdf803d85efcdce07ad8becbc52bd5) is a Transparent Upgradeable Proxy (implementation 0xdb170bfe627a39145147e6ff9b258bdb59e6b4e8, ProxyAdmin 0x9f834dd902cef1a0341bcc538cbbd8c38abe808f) governed by Felix's 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 (0x699090e73c4077ef2af42773b31788c6564f079c, zero modules, zero guard). Current MExtension code strictly enforces 1:1 M backing on wrap()/unwrap() and limits claimYield() to excess M above totalSupply() (continuous local on-chain reconciliation; 327,843.601117 M held against 327,573.275619 USDhl). Because the 3-of-6 Safe can replace the proxy implementation without a timelock, the local economic cap is unbounded and authorityPosture is unbounded-reconciled. Base M issuance is inherited from reviewed m-m0; no prudential supervisor oversees USDhl, and continuous reconciliation applies strictly to the local M/USDhl invariant rather than off-chain fiat/Treasury assurance.
